name: Merge a Brainrot Zoo
desc:
🐘🧠 Welcome to Build a Merge Zoo!

📵Brainrot Habitats EARN OFFLINE!📵
🎲 Lucky Blocks — Wait and open Lucky Blocks to discover new Brainrots!
🏞️ Habitats — Collect and unlock 25+ unique habitats for your Brainrots to thrive in.
🔗 Merge — Combine two of the same Brainrots to unlock the next-tier Brainrot!
💰 Earn — Higher-tier Brainrots bring in bigger cash rewards to grow your zoo faster.
✨ Variants — Some Brainrots can appear as Golden or Diamond for extra value!

🕹️ Play on Any Device — Seamless fun whether you’re on PC, phone, tablet, or console.

🌟 Stay Tuned — Like the game and join our community to get early peeks at upcoming habitats and easily report any issues.
